data.name: Naimiyyah
data.gender_notes: Naimiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Naim', meaning pleasure and delight. Naimiyyah is a beautiful and graceful name, evoking images of flowers and nature in full bloom. The name Naimiyyah carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Naimiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual grace and beauty of the soul.
data.etymology: Naimiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naimiyyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نعيمية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني النعمة والهناء والسعادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: النعيمية اسم مشتق من النعمة، وهي من الأسماء التي تدل على الخير والهناء. وردت النعمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والنعمة الحسناء'، وتعني السعادة والهناء الذي يتمتع به الإنسان في الدنيا والآخرة.

in_urdu.name: نعیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوشی، نیکی، اور سعادت کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: نعیمہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشیاں، نیکیاں، اور سعادت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ انسان کو اللہ کی طرف سے دی گئی نعمتوں کا شکر ادا کرنا چاہیے۔

in_hindi.name: नईमिया
in_hindi.meaning: सुख, समृद्धि और खुशी का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: नईमिया नाम का अर्थ सुख, समृद्धि और खुशी है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में प्रयोग होता है और इसका अर्थ है कि व्यक्ति को अल्लाह की ओर से दी गई नعमतों का आभारी होना चाहिए।

in_pashto.name: نعيمۍ
in_pashto.meaning: د خوښۍ، نیکۍ، او سعادت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: نعيمۍ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د خوښۍ، نیکۍ، او سعادت معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په دود کې کارول کیږي او د دې مطلب دی چې انسان باید د الله تعالیٰ لخوا ورکړل شوي نعمتونو شکر ادا کړي.

in_english.name: Naimiyyah
in_english.long_meaning: Naimiyyah is a female given name derived from the Arabic root 'n-ʿ-m', which means 'to bless' or 'to bestow happiness'. The name Naimiyyah is associated with the concept of divine blessings and happiness. In Islamic tradition, the term 'naʿīm' (نعيم) refers to the bliss and happiness of Paradise. The name Naimiyyah signifies a person who embodies these qualities, reflecting a life of joy, contentment, and spiritual fulfillment.

The name signifies the pursuit of delight and enjoyment in all aspects of life, in accordance with Islamic teachings that encourage living a balanced and fulfilling existence. The name also carries a strong sense of femininity, as many Islamic scholars have noted that the Islamic religion places significant importance on the role of women in society and their inherent beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Naimiyyah can be seen as a reminder to seek pleasure and delight in the remembrance and worship of God. It also encourages one to find happiness and joy in the blessings bestowed upon them by Allah, and to reflect upon the fleeting nature of worldly pleasures. In this way, the name represents a sacred connection between the individual and their Creator, and serves as a constant reminder to strive towards spiritual growth and development throughout one's life.
